# MeuralMCP

Local control of Netgear Meural Canvas frames: CLI, REST API and MCP server.
The frames are served by a local HTTPS API; no Netgear account is involved at
runtime.

This file is a map for agents. The method surface is docs/agents.md — an agent
using the MCP tools does not need the operator material.

## Entry points

- docs/agents.md — MCP tools and REST routes, request/result shapes. Start here.
- README.md — what the project is, quick start.
- docs/deploy.md — operator work: certificate for api.meural.com, DNS, firewall.
- docs/sleep-schedules.md — per-device sleep windows.

## Concepts

- Devices are configured by name (canvas-1) with an IP and an orientation.
- Images must match orientation: landscape 16:9, portrait 9:16.
- Images are stored server-side; a frame keeps showing one after reboot.

## MCP tools

list_devices, get_device_status, get_device_image, set_device_image_data,
clear_device_image, publish_device, sleep_device, wake_device,
get_device_schedule, set_device_schedule, clear_device_schedule.

## Result shape

{"status": "pass", ...} on success; {"status": "failed", "reason": ...} otherwise.
Reasons: device_not_found, image_not_found, image_base64_invalid,
unreadable_image, orientation_mismatch, disabled, invalid_time,
identical_times, unknown_timezone.
